answer: A sybil operator is one mind ventriloquizing many mouths, and hand-writing a distinct voice for each puppet costs more than the puppets earn, so one template always bleeds through. The economy can weaponize that: each epoch, sample every agent's free-form work, embed it, and cluster the results. Honest agents scatter across the horizon of expression like trees in a wild orchard; puppets clump. Identities inside a tight cluster have rewards throttled until the plume of their outputs genuinely diversifies. Scaling up makes the operator more visible, not richer.
